command: jq -r '((.context_window.total_input_tokens // 0) + (.context_window.total_output_tokens // 0)) as $used | ($used / 1000 | floor) as $k | (if $k >= 120 then 24 else ($k / 5 | floor) end) as $yellow | (if $k > 120 then ((($k - 120) / 5 | floor) | if . > 24 then 24 else . end) else 0 end) as $red | (reduce range(24) as $i (""; if $i < $red then . + "\u001b[38;5;203m\u2588" elif $i < $yellow then . + "\u001b[38;5;80m\u2588" else . + "\u001b[90m\u2591" end)) as $bar | $bar + "\u001b[0m " + ($used | tostring | split("") | reverse | [foreach .[] as $c (0; .+1; {c:$c,i:.})] | map(if .i > 1 and ((.i-1) % 3) == 0 then .c + "." else .c end) | reverse | join("")) + " tokens"'
